verdicts.reason: A drops the striped background to a thin sliver jammed at the left edge, and the 48H ONLY badge shrinks to an illegible dot pressed against the canvas edge. The small box floats between the copy and the CTA, so the result reads as a generic lime bar rather than the original design. B keeps the stripe panel, so the brand feel survives, and gives a clear headline-then-CTA flow. But the pink badge collides with the left edge of the box, the CTA nearly touches the end of the headline and is jammed against the right canvas edge, and the subcopy is tiny and left stranded under the headline.
